# create-neonix

> Neonix is an HTML-to-motion-video compiler: it turns HTML and CSS into a real, exportable motion video.

`create-neonix` is the official scaffolding CLI for the Neonix HTML-to-motion-video pipeline.
It generates an offline-first project containing a single, self-contained `scene.html` file
(markup, CSS and a `neonix-html-document` metadata contract) that Neonix's hosted compiler can
turn into a rendered video. The CLI itself only scaffolds and previews locally — it never
compiles or renders anything.

## FAQ

**What is create-neonix?**
A Node.js CLI (`npx create-neonix@latest`) that scaffolds a local, offline-first HTML/CSS
project for authoring Neonix video scenes. It generates `src/scene.html`, an `assets/`
directory, and supporting docs (`AGENTS.md`, `RULE.md`, `neonix-capabilities.json`).

**How do I install and use it?**
Run `npx create-neonix@latest my-video`, then `cd my-video && npm install && npm run studio`
to preview the scene locally. No account or API key is required to scaffold or preview.

**Does create-neonix compile or render video?**
No. `create-neonix` and `npm run studio` are purely local: they scaffold files and provide a
fixed-frame preview of `scene.html`. Compiling the HTML into a JSON scene document (Protocol
V2) and rendering that into a final video both happen on Neonix's hosted infrastructure at
https://www.neonix.video — not on your machine.

**How does this CLI relate to Neonix's hosted compiler?**
`create-neonix` is the authoring entry point. Once `src/scene.html` is ready, you compile and
export the video by signing in at https://www.neonix.video and uploading it manually, or by
connecting an AI agent over Remote MCP (https://www.neonix.video/docs/mcp) and having it call
`create_project_html` with the scene's contents.

**Can AI coding agents use create-neonix?**
Yes. Agents can run `npx create-neonix@latest` to scaffold a project, author `src/scene.html`
against the supported HTML/CSS subset documented in the generated `AGENTS.md`/`RULE.md`, and
then submit that file to Neonix over Remote MCP to compile and export the video.
